comment: Ids check-ids.mjs flags that pack code still has and that are real false positives. Each id has its own reason. Remove the id and its reason in the same commit as the fix. A line without a specific reason does not suppress the finding. Do not add Java block names here: replace them with the Bedrock id (deadbush, waterlily, frame, noteblock, dirt_with_roots, grass_path). Do not globally suppress a kind.

reasons.packs/build_bp/scripts/core/BlockDestroy: Pinned vanilla-data has no minecraft:end_gateway. Kept unbreakable until a native BlockTypes or command resolve proves the id invalid. Not a guess that it can be destroyed.
reasons.packs/build_bp/scripts/main.js|eb:destro: Build mode id compared with typeId. It is not an entity, item, or block. Known false positive until the comparison is narrowed.
reasons.packs/translucent_bp/entities/player.jso: Vanilla player.json damage domain copied from Mojang, not an entity id. False positive. Do not delete the vanilla copy to silence it.
